decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel remains core to the announced binding mobile communication strategy and embodies substantial sunk R&D, so management persists despite no website visibility in 2020-2021.
Mobile PDF signing directly supports the publicly announced online contract signing direction, and post-pandemic demand for remote signing lets weak results be read as temporary.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is the communicated backbone of the integrated offer, so dropping it would undermine prior commitments and be hard to justify.
The email-to-app delivery robot extends the committed secure communication channel, and modest uptake is tolerated as an early-stage effect, though its peripheral role raises some risk.
Sunk hardware investment and remaining regulated customers favor persistence, although the industry shift toward app-based authentication makes this the most vulnerable product.
